name: discover_and_register_projects
description: Scan the workspace root for git repositories, register each one as a project target, and spawn a context-generation sub-task for each unregistered repo.

args.title: Register and document all discovered repos
args.description: For each repo: 1. Identify language/framework. 2. Read README.md. 3. Write PROJECT_CONTEXT.md. 4. Call register_project.
